notes_for_editor: One usable source. The register gives location, elevation (422 ft / 129 m), a 100 ft Aermotor description with a diagonal staircase, build date unknown, registration details, the agency and one site visit dated 2/5/22. height_m 30.5 is the register's 100 ft converted. The coordinates in the register match the USGS GNIS 'Sandy Mountain' summit in Calhoun County (bulk names file) to about 0.0001 degree; not cited in the story because the GNIS file is a zip that the quote checker cannot read. A mapcarta search snippet gives the named summit as 463 ft, against the register's 422 ft for the tower; not used. Searches and page reads found no build date, builder, staffing, fire history, access rule or current condition. The Forest Lookouts Mississippi list does not include Sandy Mountain. MFC has no fire tower page in the cache (404). The story relies on the register alone; treat the 'stands' question as open. No access key set.
